title: Ordinary completed scalar model definitions
statement: For a scheme X, a commutative ring A and an adic coefficient datum d, the ordinary completed scalar model is the composite of exact constant realization over A and completed scalar extension along d. The ordinary source, target and consecutive restriction compositors are the associated exact functors on a chart and its slice [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-realization].
